title: ynf config
description: ynf's own configuration: which repositories it watches, where its state lives, and how it runs. Found at config.yaml in the home factory folder (~/.agents/factory/, or a fallback, ADR-009), or passed with --config.

repos.description: Enrolled repositories (owner/name), when there is no configuration repository. ynf reads each one's lanes from its default branch.

factory.description: The factory's configuration repository (ADR-006): its .agents/factory/factory.yaml enrols repositories, and its lanes.yaml is the default every enrolled repository's lanes are laid over. Instead of repos.

repo.description: owner/name, or host/owner/name naming the forge.

store.description: Where state lives: sqlite://<path> (relative to the config file's folder), s3://bucket/prefix or dynamodb://table. Default sqlite://state.db.

work_dir.description: Where repository mirrors and per-step worktrees live, relative to the config file's folder. Default work.

owner.description: This instance's name in leases. Default ynf@<hostname>/<pid>.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the GitHub token ynf uses for the forge. Default GITHUB_TOKEN, falling back to `gh auth token`.

author.description: The git author of commits ynf writes. Default ynf <ynf@users.noreply.github.com>.

ci.description: How often a proposed item's checks are probed. Default 30s.

review.description: How often an item in review is probed for merge, close or review. Default 5m.

build.description: Build an image with ynh image for a lane that names no published one (run.image). Default true; false on a deployed factory, so it only runs pinned, published images.

executor.description: inline: this instance runs inside containment the operator provides, such as the factory image run as a job (ADR-007). Every run then starts ynh as a process beside ynf, as inline_user, with the folders it needs handed to that user for the run; the job runner provides the network policy and capabilities. Never set it outside such a container.

inline_user.description: The user inline runs run as. Default ynh, the user agent images are built for. It must not be the user ynf runs as.

telemetry.description: OpenTelemetry (ADR-011). Without this block ynf writes where the environment says: the operator's OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*, else the spool named by YNR_SPOOL or the laptop default, else nowhere.

spool.description: The spool root, relative to the config file's folder. ynf writes its own telemetry to factory/ under it, gives each run a folder at runs/<run id>/ and a manifest at manifests/<run id>.json, and starts each run with YNR_SPOOL set to its own folder. Put it on a filesystem of its own, apart from ynf's state, such as a tmpfs (ADR-007). The root must be readable by the run user in an inline job.

run_quota.description: How large a run's folder may grow. Where the host allows it the folder is a volume of its own of that size, and a write past it fails; elsewhere ynf removes the largest files from it. Default 64MiB. ADR-007 says which executor and host gets which.

collector.description: Whether ynf starts ynr serve on the spool for the length of a factory job: sweep, serve, handle and shadow run. Off by default, and never turned on because ynr was found (ADR-012).

enabled.description: Start ynr serve for a factory job. Needs telemetry.spool and an upstream.

id.description: The collector's identity: the runner pool or the host this job runs on, stable across jobs. Never the job's own id.

instance.description: The job within the pool, such as a CI run id. It is recorded as data, not identity.

upstream.description: The OTLP/HTTP endpoint ynr serve ships to. Default: the operator's OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (or a signal's own endpoint) from the environment. ynr serve needs one until it has an object store of its own, so a collector enabled with neither fails at config load.

archive.description: How long ynr serve has at a job's end to ship what is left, after SIGTERM. Default 30s. What it has not shipped is put into the run capture.

memory.description: Memory (ADR-008). Without this block ynf uses ynm when it is on PATH and nothing otherwise (ADR-012).

provider.description: ynm, or none to switch memory off even when ynm is installed.

namespace.description: The namespace a repository's memories go to; {repo} is host/owner/name. Default factory/{repo}.

cwd.description: The directory ynm runs as if from, which picks its store; relative to the config file. Default: where ynf runs.

transport.description: cli (default): the ynm CLI, whose store memory.cwd picks. http: a hosted ynm's MCP endpoint, the shared store for a pool of workers or CI, where many writers go through one server (ADR-008).

endpoint.description: The hosted ynm's MCP endpoint, for transport http.

token_env.description: The variable holding the bearer token for transport http, such as a machine token from the identity provider's client-credentials grant: its subject is the writer in ynm's audit log.

level.description: The level ynf writes at. personal is one person's store; distributed is shared. Over http it defaults to distributed, since a hosted store keeps nothing at the personal level.
